Monthly clear signage rules
New staff will learn how a new handler works

This page covers routine desk work at the Companion Animal Travel Desk and why it matters. Clear handling at the counter keeps passengers informed, protects animal welfare, and reduces delays when travel plans change. New staff must treat every request as a safety matter, because small errors in guidance can create poor outcomes for the passenger and the animal.

Begin by listening carefully and speaking in plain language. Many passengers arrive stressed, so use short sentences, confirm the animal type, and note any travel limits before you move on. When a passenger presents documents, check them against the booking record, then pass any uncertainty to the senior coordinator without delay. Do not guess, and do not promise clearance until the required review is complete.

The passenger coordinator explains the travel steps that must be followed, but desk staff are still responsible for giving accurate, respectful direction at the point of contact. Keep your tone even, avoid jargon, and make sure the passenger understands what will happen next. If a passenger is confused, repeat the instruction once in simpler words rather than becoming abrupt. If a case involves a pet with special needs, keep the discussion calm and private so the passenger can make decisions without pressure.

You must also keep the counter organized. Clear the desk of stray papers, separate active files from completed ones, and place visible notices where passengers can see them. Good signage supports safe movement through the area and helps prevent missed steps. If a notice is faded, blocked, or out of place, report it at once and replace it through the normal service channel. Do not allow clutter to cover the information that passengers need.

Record each action promptly and accurately. Good notes help the next staff member continue the case without confusion, and they support a reliable handover if the passenger returns later. Use respectful language in all records, because the file may be read by several teams. Keep personal conversation out of the work area and stay focused on the passenger in front of you.

Remember that prompt, respectful communication is part of safe service at Aurelia Skyways.
